The app is now called **Compass**. Your settings, library and unfinished downloads carry over.

## New
- New name and a compass icon.
- On Linux the app adds its menu entry and icon on first launch, so the dock shows the compass icon while it runs. The old "Torrent Bul" menu entry is removed.

## Fixed
- With qBittorrent 5, Internet Archive downloads no longer get stuck at 0% after "Download again" or after reopening the app.

## Install
- **Linux:** the `.deb` or the `.AppImage`. Install qBittorrent first: `sudo apt install qbittorrent-nox`.
- **Windows:** `Compass.Setup.1.1.0.exe`. Install [qBittorrent](https://www.qbittorrent.org/download) first.

Only download what you have the right to download.
